thesis: The dominant defect is enforcement separation: governance describes constraints, but artifact-producing routes are not capability-restricted and gate receipts are not required before exposure.

clusters.name: DECLARATIVE_GOVERNANCE_WITHOUT_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY
clusters.system_fix: Production router issues authorization receipts only to registered engines; user-facing artifact creation requires receipt.

clusters.name: VALIDATION_NOT_ON_CRITICAL_PATH
clusters.system_fix: L7 validation and L8 exposure become blocking state transitions; NO_PASS_NO_SHOW.

clusters.name: REFERENCE_AS_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_EXECUTABLE_PARAMETERS
clusters.system_fix: Mandatory reference compiler and effect receipts.

clusters.name: AUTHORITY_COLLAPSE_ACROSS_LAYERS
clusters.system_fix: L0-L6 capability ACL: lower layers cannot mutate higher-authority layers.

clusters.name: EVIDENCE_GAP_BETWEEN_FACTS_AND_NARRATIVE
clusters.system_fix: Content identity, semantic verification, claim evidence gates.

clusters.name: CONTINUITY_WITHOUT_ARCHITECTURE_HEALTH_CHECK
clusters.system_fix: Resume mode split and surgery trigger.
